quests.name: A Warrior's Tunic
quests.offer: Every warrior of Halas starts in the tunic of the guild. Go to Tailor Freya; she will give you one for nothing. Show it to me when you wear it.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Get a Warrior's Tunic from Tailor Freya.
steps.says: Here is your tunic. Wear it well.

steps.journal: Show the Warrior's Tunic to Marik McPherson.
steps.says: Good. Now you look the part.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/halas/warrior.json, Level 1; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data).

quests.name: The Spiritmaster and the Coachman
quests.offer: A warrior who dies far from home is no use to anyone. Have the spiritmaster bind you, then see Coachman Dudley by the tunnel so you know the roads. Then come back.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Speak with the spiritmaster to be bound.
steps.says: You are bound to Halas now. Coachman Dudley waits by the tunnel.

steps.journal: Speak with Coachman Dudley by the tunnel.
steps.says: Sign here, and you can ride my coaches. Marik will want to hear of it.

steps.journal: Return to Marik McPherson.
steps.says: Bound and ready to travel. Good.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/halas/warrior.json, Level 2; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). Spiritmaster Kere is not in the database: Spiritmaster Dean, the spiritmaster beside Marik McPherson, binds instead.

quests.name: Rat Furs
quests.offer: The rats outside the gates are fat and bold. Go and kill them until you have three strands of their fur, and bring them to me.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill rats outside Halas for three strands of rat fur.
Bring the three strands of rat fur to Marik McPherson.
steps.says: Three furs. You can swing a blade, then.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/halas/warrior.json, Level 3; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). The guide's rat furs are the database's Strands of Rat Fur, from the large rats outside the gates. The Kick scroll is what the other cities' warrior guides give at level 3.

quests.name: A New Weapon
quests.offer: I will make you a proper weapon, but I need materials: an oilstone from Merchant Mallie, iron ore from Benen O'Leary in the tunnel, and a ruined bat wing from the bats outside.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Get an oilstone from Merchant Mallie.
steps.says: One oilstone. Keep it dry.

steps.journal: Get iron ore from Benen O'Leary in the tunnel.
steps.says: Good Halas iron. Mind the weight.

steps.journal: Kill bats outside Halas for a ruined bat wing.
Bring the oilstone, iron ore and bat wing to Derry McQuaid.
steps.says: That is all I need. Here is your weapon.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/halas/warrior.json, Level 4; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). The guide says to buy it; the merchant stocks none here, so it is handed over on the step. The guide does not name the weapon Derry makes, so none is given.

quests.name: The Freezeblood Wardens
quests.offer: Freezeblood goblins have set wardens in the Everfrost, southeast of the town entrance. Kill three of them and come back to me.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill three Freezeblood Wardens southeast of the town entrance.
Return to Marik McPherson.
steps.says: The wardens will think twice before coming so close again.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/halas/warrior.json, Level 5; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). The guide gives no count: three is ours. The Taunt scroll is what the other cities' warrior guides give at level 5.

quests.name: Three Tasks
quests.offer: Three tasks, west by northwest of Halas: kill a Freezeblood Icemaster for its ice axe and an Icecrusher for its icycap, and buy a Wolves of the North sash from Misty Trailer for 140 tunar. Bring me all three.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill a Freezeblood Icemaster west by northwest of Halas for its ice axe.
Kill a Freezeblood Icecrusher for its icycap.
Buy a Wolves of the North sash from Misty Trailer at the barbarian camp south of the monolith.
steps.says: One sash, 140 tunar. Wear it proudly.

steps.journal: Bring the ice axe, the icycap and the sash to Marik McPherson.
steps.says: All three. You did well.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/halas/warrior.json, Level 7; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). Misty Trailer is the database's Armorer Misty Traer at Ferris McDougal's camp. The Furious Defense scroll is what the other cities' warrior guides give at level 7.

quests.name: Thread and Feather
quests.offer: Go to Ferris McDougal at the barbarian camp south of the monolith and buy burlap thread for 145 tunar. Bring it here.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Buy burlap thread from Ferris McDougal for 145 tunar.
steps.says: Burlap thread, 145 tunar. Marik sent you, did he?

steps.journal: Bring the burlap thread to Marik McPherson.
steps.says: Good. Now I need an owl's feather: there are owls northwest of Ferris's camp. Kill one and bring me its feather.

steps.journal: Kill an owl northwest of Ferris McDougal's camp for its feather.
Bring the owl feather to Marik McPherson.
steps.says: A fine feather. Here is your reward.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/halas/warrior.json, Level 10; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). There is no White Owl in the database: the owls northwest of Ferris McDougal's camp stand in.

quests.name: Gunkat
quests.offer: A Freezeblood goblin named Gunkat guards a lone igloo west of the Halas tunnel, past the three guard towers and over the hill. Kill him and come back to me.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill the Freezeblood goblin Gunkat at the guarded igloo west of Halas.
Return to Elder Joram.
steps.says: Gunkat will trouble no more travellers. Well done.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/halas/warrior.json, Level 13; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). Eldar Joram is the database's Elder Joram, and Gunkat its Guntak (the rogue's guide spells him so). The guide's two chests are left out. The Rapid Strike scroll (the guides spell it Rabid) is what the other cities' warrior guides give at level 13.

quests.name: Trukat
quests.offer: Trukat, another Freezeblood, waits on the hill across from Gunkat's igloo. Bring me his knife. Then take 495 tunar to Ferris McDougal for a blued bear skin fur and a blued bear skin sash, and bring me those too.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill Trukat on the hill across from the guarded igloo for his knife.
Buy a blued bear skin fur and sash from Ferris McDougal for 495 tunar.
steps.says: The fur and the sash, 495 tunar.

steps.journal: Bring the knife, the fur and the sash to Elder Joram.
steps.says: You have done all I asked. Here is your reward.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/halas/warrior.json, Level 15; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). The guide says to buy it; the merchant stocks none here, so it is handed over on the step. The Stomp scroll is what the other cities' warrior guides give at level 15.

quests.name: The River Road
quests.offer: There is word to carry south along the river. Find Yarn Icefrost in his igloo west of the river, and do what he asks.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Find Yarn Icefrost in his igloo west of the river.
steps.says: Marik sent you? Then go to Pratcher in Diren's Hold, beside the banker on the second floor of the tower.

steps.journal: Find Pratcher in Diren's Hold, beside the banker on the second floor.
steps.says: Bring me two salmon from the river by the Hold.

steps.journal: Kill salmon in the river near Diren's Hold for two salmon.
Bring the two salmon to Pratcher.
steps.says: Fine fish. Now go up the mountain to Jarvan Tember.

steps.journal: Climb the mountain beside Diren's Hold to Jarvan Tember.
steps.says: Tell Marik his warrior has done well.

steps.journal: Return to Marik McPherson.
steps.says: Elder Joram is waiting for you.

steps.journal: Speak with Elder Joram for your reward.
steps.says: You have earned your place among the warriors of Halas.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/halas/warrior.json, Level 20; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). Deltor Cyclor, the fisherman who points the way to Yarn Icefrost, is not in the database: that step is left out. The guide's final choice of path (two rewards) is not in: the quest gives its experience only. (Life Path: Blade of War and Pillar of Might; Strength Path: Bellow and a Sword of Rage.) Eldar Joram is Elder Joram.

quests.name: A Rogue's Tunic
quests.offer: Before anything else, you need to look like one of us. Tailor McQuaid has a Rogue's Tunic for you. Fetch it and come back.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Get a Rogue's Tunic from Tailor McQuaid.
steps.says: One Rogue's Tunic. Quietly, now.

steps.journal: Show the Rogue's Tunic to Juno Felligan.
steps.says: It suits you.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/halas/rogue.json, Level 1; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data).

quests.name: The Spiritmaster and the Coachman
quests.offer: Speak to Spiritmaster Dean and be bound here. Then see Coachman Dudley, just before the tunnel. Report back to me after.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Speak with Spiritmaster Dean to be bound.
steps.says: You are bound to Halas. Coachman Dudley is just before the tunnel.

steps.journal: Speak with Coachman Dudley before the tunnel.
steps.says: Now you can ride the coaches. Off you go back to Juno.

steps.journal: Return to Juno Felligan.
steps.says: Good. You know your way out of town now.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/halas/rogue.json, Level 2; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data).

quests.name: A Secret Seasoning
quests.offer: The Seeing Eye is low on its secret seasoning: spider eyes. The spiders inside the gates of Halas have them. Bring me two.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill spiderlings by the gates of Halas for two spider eyes.
Bring the spider eyes to Juno Felligan.
steps.says: The Seeing Eye thanks you, even if it does not know it.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/halas/rogue.json, Level 3; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). Two eyes is ours (the guide gives no count); they are the database's small spider eye, from the spiderlings by the gates.

quests.name: Gannon's Knife
quests.offer: I will make you a knife, but I need an oilstone from Merchant Mallie, iron ore from Benen O'Leary in the tunnel out of town, and two chipped raven beaks from the birds outside Halas.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Get an oilstone from Merchant Mallie.
steps.says: One oilstone.

steps.journal: Get iron ore from Benen O'Leary in the tunnel.
steps.says: Iron ore for Gannon, is it?

steps.journal: Kill crows outside Halas for two chipped raven beaks.
Bring the oilstone, iron ore and two beaks to Gannon MacGibson.
steps.says: Here is your knife. Keep it sharp.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/halas/rogue.json, Level 4; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). The guide says to buy it; the merchant stocks none here, so it is handed over on the step. Merchant Millie is Merchant Mallie and Bennon O'Leary is Benen O'Leary. The beaks come from the crows outside the gates (the guide's ravens, crows and magpies). The Chipped Raven's Beak Knife is the database's Raven Beak Knife.

quests.name: The Warden's Headband
quests.offer: A band of goblins is headed toward Halas. Slay one of their wardens and bring me its headband.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Slay a Freezeblood Warden southeast of the entrance for its headband.
Bring the Warden's Headband to Juno Felligan.
steps.says: They will know we are watching.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/halas/rogue.json, Level 5; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). The Warden's Headband is the database's Goblin Warden's Headband.

quests.name: Watcher's Vest
quests.offer: Ice Fang spiderlings have been scaring the women out of the caravans and fouling the food. Slay one south of the Halas gates and bring me a fang.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Slay an Icefang Spiderling south of the Halas gates for a fang.
Bring the fang to Juno Felligan.
steps.says: The caravans can rest easier. Take this vest.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/halas/rogue.json, Level 7; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). Reward left out (not in the database): item Watcher's Vest.

quests.name: The Ice Spider Queen
quests.offer: Let us see what you have learned. Far to the west lives the Ice Spider Queen, sometimes among wolves. Slay her and bring me two strands of her silk, and I will forge you a weapon.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Slay the Ice Spider Queen far to the west for two strands of spider silk.
Bring the two strands of spider silk to Juno Felligan.
steps.says: This silk will bind a fine blade.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/halas/rogue.json, Level 10; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). Reward left out (not in the database): item The Slicer's Special.

quests.name: Battle Plans
quests.offer: Freezeblood captains have been seen west of Halas, south by the spider queens, at a camp with an igloo. They carry battle plans. Bring me two.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill Freezeblood captains at the igloo camp west of Halas for two battle plans.
Bring the two battle plans to Iron Eagle.
steps.says: These plans tell us much.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/halas/rogue.json, Level 13; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data).

quests.name: Numla
quests.offer: The plans name an assassin, Numla, in the Freezeblood camp by the water, near a large wooden T. Slay him before he finishes his work and bring me his bag of tricks, and a raven's tail feather from Shawndy McKibbin.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Slay the assassin Numla north of the Freezeblood camp, by the wooden T at the water.
Buy a raven's tail feather from Shawndy McKibbin.
steps.says: One raven's tail feather.

steps.journal: Bring the bag of tricks and the feather to Iron Eagle.
steps.says: Numla is finished, and so is his mission.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/halas/rogue.json, Level 15; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). The guide says to buy it; the merchant stocks none here, so it is handed over on the step. Shwandy McKibbin is Shawndy McKibbin. Reward left out (not in the database): item Raven Stalkers.

quests.name: Yarn's Answer
quests.offer: The Freezebloods plan another attack: each clan sends someone to speak with Yarn Icefrost, camped south among the trees he planted. Take him this sealed letter and do as he says.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Take the sealed letter from Juno Felligan.
steps.says: Here is the letter.

steps.journal: Bring the sealed letter to Yarn Icefrost in his cabin among the trees west of the river.
steps.says: Take this to Brenn Raven across the river to the south, and wait there for word from me.

steps.journal: Bring Yarn's letter to Brenn Raven.
steps.says: While you wait, catch two salmon for our dinner.

steps.journal: Kill salmon in the river for two salmon.
Bring the two salmon to Brenn Raven.
steps.says: Good. Now see Jarvan Tember on the hill behind the village.

steps.journal: See Jarvan Tember on the hill behind Brenn's village.
steps.says: Take this letter back to Juno.

steps.journal: Bring Jarvan's letter to Juno Felligan.
steps.says: Now take my letter to Iron Eagle.

steps.journal: Bring Juno's letter to Iron Eagle.
steps.says: You have served Halas well.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/halas/rogue.json, Level 20; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). Deltor Cyclor, the fisherman who points the way to Yarn Icefrost, is not in the database: that step is left out. The guide's final choice of path (two rewards) is not in: the quest gives its experience only. (Defensive or offensive, the offensive a backstab.) Bren Raven is Brenn Raven.

quests.name: A Shepherd's Mantle
quests.offer: A shaman of Halas wears the Shepherd's Mantle. Tailor Akesson will give you one for nothing. Show it to me.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Get a Shepherd's Mantle from Tailor Akesson.
steps.says: Here is your mantle.

steps.journal: Show the Shepherd's Mantle to Beril O'Leary.
steps.says: The spirits will know you now.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/halas/shaman.json, Level 1; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data).

quests.name: The Spiritmaster and the Coachman
quests.offer: Talk to Spiritmaster Lera; she will bind you. Then go and see Coachman Dudley, and come back to me.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Speak with Spiritmaster Lera to be bound.
steps.says: You are bound to Halas. Go and see Coachman Dudley.

steps.journal: Speak with Coachman Dudley by the tunnel.
steps.says: Now you know the coaches. Back to Beril with you.

steps.journal: Return to Beril O'Leary.
steps.says: Good.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/halas/shaman.json, Level 2; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data).

quests.name: Rat Fur
quests.offer: Kill the rats outside town and bring me three strands of their fur.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill rats outside Halas for three strands of rat fur.
Bring the three strands of rat fur to Beril O'Leary.
steps.says: These will do.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/halas/shaman.json, Level 3; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). The guide's rat furs are the database's Strands of Rat Fur, from the large rats outside the gates. The Tribal Toughness scroll is the class's level 3 spell, the scroll the guides that name one give for this quest.

quests.name: Trista's Weapon
quests.offer: I will make you a new weapon if you bring me an oilstone from Merchant Mallie, a bar of iron ore from Benen O'Leary, and small spider eyes from the spiderlings.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Get an oilstone from Merchant Mallie.
steps.says: One oilstone.

steps.journal: Get a bar of iron ore from Benen O'Leary in the tunnel.
steps.says: A bar of iron ore.

steps.journal: Kill spiderlings for two small spider eyes.
Bring the oilstone, iron ore and spider eyes to Trista.
steps.says: Here is your weapon.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/halas/shaman.json, Level 4; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). The guide says to buy it; the merchant stocks none here, so it is handed over on the step. Two eyes is ours. The guide does not name the weapon, so none is given.

quests.name: The Freezeblood Wardens
quests.offer: Freezeblood wardens lurk in the Everfrost, southeast of the town entrance. Kill three of them.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill three Freezeblood Wardens southeast of the town entrance.
Return to Beril O'Leary.
steps.says: The spirits are pleased.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/halas/shaman.json, Level 5; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). The guide gives no count: three is ours. The Blighting Mist scroll is the class's level 5 spell, the scroll the guides that name one give for this quest.

quests.name: Steel Bars
quests.offer: The Freezeblood hordes carry steel bars. They camp with the icemasters and icecrushers west by northwest of Halas. Bring me two.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill Freezeblood hordes west by northwest of Halas for two steel bars.
Bring the two steel bars to Beril O'Leary.
steps.says: Good steel.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/halas/shaman.json, Level 7; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). The Minor Malady scroll is the class's level 7 spell, the scroll the guides that name one give for this quest.

quests.name: Nilmo's Feathers
quests.offer: Go to Nilmo at the barbarian camp south of the monolith, west along the mountains. He has work for you.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Find Nilmo at the barbarian camp south of the monolith.
steps.says: Beril sent you? Kill two owls northwest of here and bring me their feathers.

steps.journal: Kill owls northwest of Nilmo's camp for two feathers.
Bring the two feathers to Nilmo.
steps.says: Thank you. Tell Beril I am grateful.

steps.journal: Return to Beril O'Leary.
steps.says: Nilmo speaks well of you.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/halas/shaman.json, Level 10; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). There is no White Owl in the database: the owls northwest of Ferris McDougal's camp stand in. Nilmo is the database's Nilmo McPherson.

quests.name: Tribunal Rings
quests.offer: Freezeblood scavengers wander west of the gate, past the Icecrusher lake and the guard towers, where Trukat and Gunkat spawn. Kill them and bring me three Tribunal Rings.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill Freezeblood scavengers west of Halas for three Tribunal Rings.
Bring the three Tribunal Rings to Elder Felligan.
steps.says: These rings should never have left the Tribunal.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/halas/shaman.json, Level 13; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). The Tribal Brawn scroll is the class's level 13 spell, the scroll the guides that name one give for this quest.

quests.name: Kurnor
quests.offer: The Freezebloods' leader, Kurnor, keeps an igloo west beyond the guard towers, past the gap in the mountains, left along the river. Kill him and bring me his necklace.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill Kurnor at his igloo west of Halas for his necklace.
Bring Kurnor's necklace to Elder Felligan.
steps.says: Kurnor is gone. Go and tell Beril O'Leary.

steps.journal: Tell Beril O'Leary of Kurnor's fall.
steps.says: Good news. Go back to Elder Felligan.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Felligan.
steps.says: You have done well.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/halas/shaman.json, Level 15; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). The Endure Poison scroll is the class's level 15 spell, the scroll the guides that name one give for this quest.

quests.name: The River Road
quests.offer: Find Yarn Icefrost in his igloo west of the river south of Halas, and do what he asks.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Find Yarn Icefrost in his igloo west of the river.
steps.says: Go to Firemaster Drumm in Diren's Hold, beside the banker on the second floor.

steps.journal: Find Firemaster Drumm in Diren's Hold.
steps.says: Bring me two salmon from the river by the Hold.

steps.journal: Kill salmon in the river near Diren's Hold for two salmon.
Bring the two salmon to Firemaster Drumm.
steps.says: Now go to Jarvan Tember on the mountain top.

steps.journal: Climb the mountain beside Diren's Hold to Jarvan Tember.
steps.says: Go home to Beril.

steps.journal: Return to Beril O'Leary.
steps.says: Elder Felligan has your reward.

steps.journal: Speak with Elder Felligan for your reward.
steps.says: The spirits of Halas walk with you.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/halas/shaman.json, Level 20; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). Deltor Cyclor, the fisherman who points the way to Yarn Icefrost, is not in the database: that step is left out. The guide's final choice of path (two rewards) is not in: the quest gives its experience only. (A one-handed weapon and a pet buff, or a two-handed spear and Decaying Wind.) The guide says 2 million XP; the other cities' level 20 guides give 2,814,929.

items.name: Bag of Tricks
items.description: The assassin Numla's bag of tricks.
